items.title: ChatGPT helped me find a problem I didn’t know I had
items.summary: I run a small store and don’t really know much about how ChatGPT works. A customer came in recently asking about a product we stopped selling months ago. I asked where they saw it and they said ChatGPT recommended it. So I checked ChatGPT myself and yep, it was still recommending the old product. I told it the product was discontinued and asked why it was still recommending it. I figured that would do it. Nope. Still there.
